selection.note: Fewer alternatives mean no additional canonical rotation cleared the metric-difference threshold.

water.source: NASA POWER · https://www.nrcs.usda.gov/sites/default/files/2022-08/SSURGO-Metadata-Table-Column-Descriptions-Report.pdf · crop catalog and irrigation assumption
water.explanation: Lower unmet crop water demand after a daily soil-water bucket and assumed irrigation.

nitrogen.explanation: The previous crop's carryover credit offsets the current crop's assumed nitrogen demand.

erosion.source: NASA SRTM · NASA POWER · crop cover assumptions
erosion.explanation: Lower slope, lower daily rainfall intensity or more cover reduces a simplified RUSLE-style index.

climate_fit.explanation: Share of complete historical crop windows meeting the crop's temperature, rainfall and heat screens.

income.explanation: The catalog's relative income index is a scenario input. It gives no price or yield forecast.

risk.source: Crop catalog · disease family and cover assumptions
risk.explanation: Consecutive crops in the same family and uncovered fallow raise the risk proxy.
